# Research brief

For each important finding include claim, evidence, primary source, community evidence when useful, confidence, trade-offs, risks, maturity, and recommendation. Preserve uncertain or conflicting evidence instead of flattening it.

Do not make an architecture decision; hand a brief to Project Architect. Exit with a durable research artifact.
